function: MIMO channel estimation from pilots with a diffusion-model generative prior, using a lightweight CNN trained in the angular domain. pp. 1-3
system: Massive MIMO uplink, MT with Ntx = 16 antennas, BS with Nrx = 64, full pilots Np = Ntx, ULAs; no RIS; 6 GHz for QuaDRiGa. pp. 2-3
method: Diffusion model with lightweight CNN and SNR positional embedding, trained offline on 100,000 channels by ELBO maximization (generative, unsupervised); online reverse steps from the pilot LS estimate. pp. 2-4
data_channel: 3GPP spatial channel model [16] with three clusters (Fig. 2) and QuaDRiGa v2.4 urban macrocell LOS at 6 GHz (Fig. 3); 100,000 training samples. pp. 3-4
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same channel model (100,000 training samples each); SNR from -15 to 20 dB; SNR-information offset of ±3 dB. pp. 3-5
baselines: Classical: LS, sample-covariance MMSE (Scov), genie-covariance MMSE bound. Learned: GMM, GMM Kron, score-based estimator (Score). Ablation: DM spatial. pp. 4-5
metrics: Normalized MSE versus SNR; MSE versus number of DM steps and over intermediate steps; parameter count; online complexity order. pp. 4-5
complexity: Table I: DM has 5.50·10^4 parameters and online complexity O(N(ℓ̂k²Cmax²+log N)); Score has 5.89·10^6 parameters, O(LscDJk²Cmax²N). p. 4
openness: Simulation code at https://github.com/benediktfesl/Diffusion_channel_est (footnote 1, p. 3); no data link beyond the simulators.
q1_support: p. 3: "version 2.4 of the QuaDRiGa channel simulator [17] is used"; the 3GPP spatial channel model [16] (TR 25.996) is also used for Fig. 2.
q2_support: p. 3: "All data-aided approaches are trained on Mtrain = 100,000 training samples"; no model trained on one channel model or setting is tested on another, and the SNR sweep and the ±3 dB SNR-information offset (p. 4) are not new scenarios.
q3_support: p. 4: "classical and generative prior-aided baselines" and "We also evaluate the score-based channel estimator from [10]"; LS, Scov, and genie are non-learned, and the MSE is compared with all of them in Figs. 2-3.
q4_support: p. 4: "the online complexity for the channel estimation are analyzed in Table I"; Table I lists 5.50·10^4 parameters and O(N(ℓ̂k²Cmax²+log N)) for the proposed DM.
q5_support: p. 3: "publicly available simulation code"; footnote 1 gives https://github.com/benediktfesl/Diffusion_channel_est.
notes: QuaDRiGa counts for q1. The 3GPP spatial channel model of TR 25.996 [16] (p. 3) is another standardized model, to be confirmed by the reviewer. The DM spatial variant is an ablation, not a learned baseline. Table I and Figs. 2 to 4 were also read on the page images.
